info.title: payment-api
info.description: The payment HTTP routes and OpenAPI contract over the chain-neutral wallet and index abstractions. An asset is its network's own asset id (`native`, or a token); no chain or asset is named in this contract.

get.summary: Read readiness and every indexed network's indexing
get.description: Public readiness: ready when at least one network is indexed and no index job is failing (failed, or going again with a `reason`). Reads the `network_index` rows and the job queue; no RPC.
The contract every route is generated from; public, like the health routes.

500.description: The contract could not be encoded

get.description: Every asset of every configured network, with its metadata. This is the only list of assets the wallet routes accept.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Only jobs of this chain; with `network`.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Only jobs of this network of `chain`.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Only jobs in this state; absent, every state but `idle`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query, cursor, or limit, or a chain without its network

get.description: The job's outcome, what it was given and what its worker has done; for a broadcast, the transaction it recorded and whether it was sent.

get.summary: List every network, its assets, its RPC nodes, its indexing and its live tip
get.description: Every stored network: its row, its assets, its nodes (each URL with what the running server knows of it: last tip, failure streak, calls) and its `index` row (null: not indexed), and why its index job last failed (`index_job_reason`). `tip_live` asks every running network's node at once, each for at most 2 s; one that fails keeps the stored `tip` and says why in `tip_error`.

503.description: The networks could not be read

post.summary: Add RPC nodes to one or more networks
post.description: Appends each node after its network's current ones, stores every changed list in one write (all or none), then sends every later call of those networks to their new lists. A provider's nodes for several networks are added at once this way.

400.description: Malformed node, a list above 16 nodes, or a node that fails or serves another chain

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

get.summary: List a network's last kept blocks
get.description: Live kept blocks, latest first, a page at a time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query, cursor, or limit

get.summary: Read one kept block of a network

404.description: The network is not configured, or no live block is kept at this position

get.summary: List a live block's kept transactions

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query, cursor, or limit

404.description: The network is not configured, or no live block is kept at this position

get.description: Its stored nodes in stored order: each one's id and URL, as `PUT` takes them, and what the running server knows of it (`state`: last tip, failure streak, calls).

503.description: The nodes could not be read

put.description: Stores the nodes, then sends every later call of the network (indexing, wallets, broadcast) to them: the healthy node with the highest tip first, then the others in order; calls already sent finish on the node they reached. Each node is asked its chain and tip once, before storing. A URL already stored keeps its id, routes and state; one left out is removed with its routes.

400.description: Malformed node list, or a node that fails or serves another chain

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

post.summary: Add RPC nodes to a network
post.description: Appends the nodes after the network's current ones, stores the list, then sends every later call of the network to it.

400.description: Malformed node, a list above 16 nodes, or a node that fails or serves another chain

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

delete.summary: Remove one RPC node of a network
delete.description: Removes the node `id` and its routes, stores the rest and uses them from now on. A network's last node cannot be removed.

400.description: It is the network's last node

404.description: No such node, or network not configured

503.description: The nodes could not be stored

get.description: Each routed method and the nodes taking turns serving it, round robin. Every other method goes to the network's healthy node with the highest tip.

503.description: The routes could not be read

put.description: Stores the routes, then sends each routed method round robin over its nodes, and every other method to the healthy node with the highest tip. A routed call failing retryably moves to the next node, then to the network's other nodes. No node is asked.

400.description: An empty method, a method routed twice, or a node that is missing, repeated or of another network

503.description: The routes could not be stored

get.summary: Find a network's last block at or before a time, streaming the search
get.description: `text/event-stream`, read from the node: `event: probe` with `{"low":{"position","timestamp"},"high":{…}}` after each step of the binary search (the range narrows: the block is at or after `low`, before `high`); then `event: found` with `{"position","timestamp"}`, or `event: error` with `{"message"}` (cannot find blocks by time, before the first block, the node failed). The stream then ends.

parameters.name: at
parameters.description:
RFC 3339 time (`2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`) or Unix seconds: find the last
block at or before it.

400.description: Malformed `at`

get.summary: List a network's transactions, or only its pending ones

parameters.name: pending
parameters.description:
Only pending ones (true), oldest sent first; otherwise (the default)
pending and mined in live blocks, newest first.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query, cursor, or limit

get.description: Counts across every network, and per hour over the last day: blocks and transactions by chain time (up to the newest kept block), jobs and trigger runs by this server's time.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

post.description: Stores every trigger or none, all on one configured network, each with an `id` chosen here that never changes: a template of several triggers (gas funding and sweep) never lands half.

400.description: Malformed body or id, several networks, or a send from This to This

404.description: Network or sent asset is not configured

422.description: An id is taken or repeated

put.description: Replaces everything but its id and creation time; a body `id` is refused. Setting `enabled` to false pauses it.

400.description: Malformed body, or a send from This to This

404.description: No such trigger, or network not configured

delete.summary: Delete a trigger and its runs

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query, cursor, or limit

get.description: Keyed wallets and watched addresses, a page in wallet ID order, each with its tags and its indexes: their balances (exact atomic units), progress and legs.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

post.summary: Import a wallet's key, watch an address, or generate a wallet, in one configured network
post.description: With `secret`, imports a raw private key and keeps it; with `address` too, the key must derive that address. With `address` alone, watches it without its key. With neither, generates a key and keeps it; retrying makes another wallet. The wallet is created without indexes (`POST /v1/wallets/{id}/index`). An address already kept answers its wallet as is (200), except that importing the key of a watch-only wallet keeps the key, and an `external_id` is kept on a wallet that has none (a kept one stays); its tags and indexes stay.

200.description: The address was already kept: its wallet

400.description: Malformed body, address, key or external ID, or a key that derives another address

503.description: Generation or the store is unavailable

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed query or limit

get.description: The wallet's network, canonical address, whether it is keyed, the assets it is indexed in and how far each is; never its key.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `{chain}.{network}.{address}`, as a create call returned it.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID

post.summary: Index a wallet in an asset
post.description: Indexes the wallet in `asset` from `start` (absent: the chain's tip), at once (the network's next indexing step picks it). An asset already indexed keeps its first start (200). A `start` below the chain's tip less the network's `max_depth` is refused (400). On a chain that reads balances (Solana, Ethereum) the index starts at the chain's final block whatever `start` says (kept as `requested_from`): its balances are null until the chain's balance read there opens it with an `adjustment` leg. A start the node no longer serves moves forward to the first block it serves before indexing begins.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: `{chain}.{network}.{address}`, as a create call returned it.

200.description: The asset was already indexed: its index

400.description: Malformed body or wallet ID, or a start below the chain's tip less the network's `max_depth`

404.description: Wallet is unknown, or the asset is not configured

503.description: The node or the store is unavailable

delete.summary: Stop indexing a wallet in an asset
delete.description: Forgets the index and its progress: its balance and history are no longer read. Creating it again starts from its new start.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID

patch.summary: Pause or resume a wallet's index
patch.description: `paused`: skipped, no facts kept for blocks while paused; what is kept stays. `indexing`: from `paused` or `no_data` (clearing its reason), it continues from its last indexed block, backfilling what it missed. On a chain that reads balances (Solana, Ethereum) one left behind the chain's final block is not read back: its balance is read there and one `adjustment` leg closes the gap.

400.description: Malformed body or wallet ID, or `no_data` asked for

get.description: The index's legs in live blocks, latest first, each with the balance right after it. Its pending legs are on the index itself.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: `next_cursor` of the previous page; absent for the first page.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID, query, cursor, or limit

post.summary: Reconcile a wallet's index with the chain's balance
post.description: Deletes the index's mined legs above the chain's final block and unsets its progress: its balances read null until the next indexing step reads the chain's balance at a final block, appends one `adjustment` leg of the difference and reads on from there. Pending legs stay. Corrects what indexing cannot see, such as ether a contract sent. Only on chains that read balances (Solana, Ethereum).

400.description: Malformed wallet ID

422.description: The chain reads no balance (Bitcoin), or the index is paused or `no_data`

503.description: The indexer has not read the chain's final block yet, or the store is unavailable

put.description: Tags the wallet, keyed or watch-only; tagging twice keeps one tag.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID or tag

404.description: Wallet is unknown, or network not configured

delete.description: Removes the tag from the wallet.

400.description: Malformed wallet ID or tag

404.description: No such wallet or tag, or network not configured

post.summary: Enqueue a payment from a wallet
post.description: Enqueues one send job of `asset` from the keyed wallet: one payment, signed as one transaction and broadcast. Several payments are several requests; a wallet's sends run one at a time, in order, and each fails on its own. A 202 response means queued, not submitted: `GET /v1/jobs/{id}` reports the outcome. Indexing records the transaction once it is mined, for the assets the wallet is watched in. A watch-only wallet answers 422.

400.description: Malformed body, wallet ID, amount, or destination

404.description: Network or asset is not configured

503.description: The queue or store is unavailable

Asset.description: Metadata of the asset an amount is denominated in.

decimals.description: Decimal places between atomic and display units.

display_decimals.description: Fractional digits a view shows; always present, null: all.

id.description: Asset ID within the chain (`native` or a token identifier).

name.description: Display name, when known; always present.

ticker.description: Ticker symbol, when known; always present.

assets.description: Assets in network, then id, order.

Block.description:
A kept block: its `block` row; the API shows it as is. Written with its
kept transactions in block order and its kept rewards, which are never
read back into it.

parent.description: Its parent's id, once that is kept.

parent_position.description: Its parent's position; null for genesis.

reorged_at.description: Unix ms a reorg took it back; null while live.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

BlockTransactions.description:
`GET /v1/networks/{chain}/{network}/blocks/{position}/transactions`: a
page of a block's transactions.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

transactions.description: The transactions, with their legs, in block order.

ChainHour.description: One hour of chain time, across every network.

transactions.description: Kept transactions mined in those blocks.

ConfiguredNetwork.description:
One network as stored: its `network` row, its `network_asset` rows, its
`network_endpoint` nodes and their routes, and its `network_index` row (`None`: not
indexed); and the node's tip asked now (`tip_live`, the stored `tip`
until a caller that asked sets it; `tip_error`, why asking failed).

block_time_ms.description: The chain's block (slot) time, in milliseconds.

chain_id.description:
The chain's own id of the network (Ethereum chain id, Solana genesis
hash); always present, null where the name is enough.

confirmations.description: Positions below the tip before a block counts as confirmed.

enabled.description: Whether the server starts indexing it.

endpoints.description: Its nodes as stored, in failover order.

explorer_address.description:
An address's explorer page, `{address}` filled in; always present,
null: none.

explorer_transaction.description:
A transaction's explorer page, `{tx}` filled in; always present,
null: none.

oneOf.description: Its indexing; always present, null: not indexed.

index_job_reason.description:
Why its index job's last run failed (the job's `reason`), cleared by
the next run that does not; always present, null: none.

max_depth.description:
How many positions below the tip a wallet's start may be; at least
`confirmations`. Always present, null: no limit. Null on a chain that
reads balances (Solana, Ethereum): its line is the chain's final block.

routes.description:
Its routed methods, each over its own nodes; every other method goes
to all of them.

settings.description: The chain's own knobs; an absent key is the chain's default.

testnet.description: Whether its coins are test coins.

tip_error.description: Why asking the node failed; always present, null when it answered.

tip_live.description:
The node's newest block, asked now; the stored `tip` when that
failed. Always present.

CreateWallet.description:
`POST /v1/wallets` body: a wallet in one network, created without
indexes. With `secret`, its key is imported and kept; else with
`address`, the address is watched without a key; with neither, a new key
is generated and kept.

address.description:
Address text in any form the chain accepts; with `secret`, the
address the key must derive.

external_id.description:
Your own reference for the wallet (e.g. your customer id), 1 to 128
characters once trimmed; not unique.

secret.description:
A raw private key in the chain's import format: Ethereum hex, Solana
Base58 secret or keypair, Bitcoin WIF.

asset.description: The asset id to index the wallet in.

start.description:
The native position to index from, at or above the chain's tip less
the network's `max_depth` (a chain that reads balances starts at its
final block instead). Absent: from the chain's tip, as a generated
wallet (it has no past) must be.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every error response.

FeeLevel.description:
How fast a payment should land: Ethereum tips at half, the same or twice
the node's suggestion; Bitcoin targets confirmation within 12 blocks, the
network's target or the next block; Solana pays no priority fee yet.

accepted.description: Whether it was sent: a node accepted it, or may hold it (false for other kinds).

attempts.description: Executions started since it was last fresh.

created_at.description: When it was queued, Unix ms.

deadline.description: Not started after this, Unix ms; always present.

progress.description: What its worker has done so far; always present.

reason.description:
Why it failed, or why its last attempt is being retried; always
present.

run_at.description: Not started before this, Unix ms: the next run of a pending job.

topic.description: What it locks: jobs whose topics conflict run one at a time, in line order.

txid.description:
A broadcast's transaction (txid), once recorded; always present,
null before and for other kinds.

updated_at.description: When it was last written, Unix ms: started, retried or finished.

jobs.description: The jobs last written, latest first.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

confirmed.description: The confirmed block position it decided at.

refused.description: Why it was refused (it then acted on nothing); always present.

LastRound.description: A trigger's last round, whether it acted or not.

Leg.description:
One `leg` row: a transaction's leg, a block's reward, or an index's
adjustment; the API shows it as is.

amount.description: Exact atomic decimal text; signed for a reward or an adjustment.

archived_at.description:
A received coin a jump wrote off: that jump's position; never
spendable again. Null otherwise.

kind.description:
0 received, 1 spent, 2 burned, 3 minted, 4 fee, 5 reward, 6
adjustment (signed; leg 0: what the chain's balance read corrects the
index's total by, at the block it was read at; leg 1: the coins a
jump archived).

seq.description:
Its index's leg sequence: 1 + the highest the index has kept,
unique per index; `None` while pending.

total.description: Its index's balance right after it; `None` while pending.

total_received.description:
What its index has received (received, minted, reward) through it;
`None` while pending. No adjustment counts.

total_sent.description:
What its index has sent (spent, burned, fee) through it; `None` while
pending. `total` is `total_received - total_sent` plus its index's
adjustments so far.

transaction.description: Its transaction; null for a reward or an adjustment.

wallet_index_id.description: The wallet index it is kept for: its address's index in its asset.

legs.description:
Live mined legs, latest first, each with the balance after it
(`total`) and its transaction's txid and state (null for a reward).

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

Listing.description: One configured asset: its id, where its wallets live, and what they hold.

asset.description:
The id every wallet route's `asset` takes within `network`: `native`,
or a token's chain-owned id.

network.description: The chain and network this asset's wallets live on.

timestamp.description: Its block's time, Unix seconds, when the node reported one.

Movement.description:
A mined leg with its transaction's txid and state (null for a reward or
an adjustment) and its block's time: a row of [`db::find_page`].

Network.description:
The chain and network a wallet, address, or transaction belongs to. It
always ships as one nested object, never as two sibling fields.

NetworkAsset.description: One asset of a network: its native currency or a token.

contract.description:
The token's contract (mint); always present, null for the native
currency.

decimals.description: Fractional digits between the display unit and the atomic unit.

display_decimals.description: Fractional digits a view shows; always present, null: all.

endpoints.description: Its nodes as stored, in failover order.

networks.description: Networks in chain, then name, order.

NetworkIndex.description:
One network's indexing as its indexer last wrote it; the counters since
the row was made, across restarts.

checked_at.description: Unix ms of the indexer's last read whose tip moved; always present.

failures.description: Failed steps; why the last failed is the index job's `reason`.

indexed.description: The last kept block; always present, null: none yet.

reorgs.description: Kept blocks reorged because the chain took them back.

tip.description:
The node's newest block at the indexer's last read; always present,
null before the first.

networks.description: Networks in chain, then name, order.

NetworkNode.description: One node to add, and its network.

endpoint.description: The node's URL, written as `endpoints` writes one.

routes.description: By method; each one's nodes in failover order.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

Report.description: The health of every indexed network.

ready.description: At least one network, and no index job failing.

nodes.description: Nodes to append, each after its network's current ones, in order.

RpcNode.description: One stored node of a network.

id.description: Its id: what a route and removal name.

oneOf.description:
What the running server knows of it; always present, null where it
is not running (its network is not, or its URL did not build).

RpcNodeState.description:
What the running server knows of one node: its last tip, its failure
streak, and its calls since it was loaded. Nothing asks the node.

calls.description: Calls that reached it and finished.

failed_calls.description: Of those, the ones that failed.

failures.description:
Retryable failures in a row (a rate limit counts as 3); from 3 it is
tried after every other node until it answers, or 10 block times (at
least 30 s) pass.

last_failure.description:
The last failure's kind or code, never a message of the node's;
always present, null: none.

tip.description:
Its newest block (slot) when last asked, kept for the network's block
time; always present, null before it told one.

endpoints.description:
One to 16 distinct node URLs, in failover order. A URL carries everything:
userinfo (HTTP Basic), query keys, a key in the path,
`header.<Name>=value` parameters sent as headers, and `rpc.` settings
(`timeout_ms`, `max_request_bytes`, `max_response_bytes`, `max_batch`,
`rps`: most calls a second, e.g. `3.5`; a request waits for its turn).

RpcRoute.description: One method and the endpoints taking turns serving it.

endpoint_ids.description: The network's endpoints taking turns, by id.

method.description: The JSON-RPC method, exactly as sent, e.g. `getBlock`.

routes.description:
Every route of the network; empty: none. A method appears once, over
one or more of the network's node ids, each once.

RunJob.description: One send job of a run.

reason.description:
Why it failed, or why its last attempt is being retried; always
present.

RunOutcome.description: Where a run's jobs are together.

Send.description:
`POST /v1/wallets/{id}/transactions` body: one payment from the path's
wallet in one asset.

amount.description: Exact positive decimal in display units.

asset.description: An asset id of the wallet's network; default `native`.

destination.description: Recipient address text, as the wallet's chain writes it.

fee.description:
How fast it should land; each chain prices it its own way. Default
`normal`.

ServerHour.description: One hour of this server's time.

failed.description: Jobs that failed for good in it.

addresses.description: Distinct addresses indexed, keyed or watch-only.

chain.description:
The last day of chain time (up to the newest kept block), hour by
hour, oldest first.

enabled.description: Of those, how many are enabled.

server.description: The last day of this server's time, hour by hour, oldest first.

transactions.description: Transactions kept mined in live blocks.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

tags.description:
Tags in use on any wallet, sorted, each once. A wallet's own tags are
on it (`GET /v1/wallets`).

Transaction.description:
A kept transaction: its `transaction` row and its kept legs. The API
shows it as is. Read in one query: its legs come as a JSON array SQLite
builds (`legs`).

order.description: Its position in its block; null while pending.

position.description: Its block's position; null while pending.

reason.description: Why it reverted (JSON), when the chain said; null otherwise.

sent_at.description:
Unix ms it was sent: a node accepted it, or may hold it; null while
recorded but not yet sent, and once mined.

Trigger.description: One `trigger` row; the API shows it as is.

action.description:
What it does: `{"name": "send", "input": {"source": target, "asset":
id, "destination": target, "amount": amount}}`.

check.description:
When it acts: `{"since": {"seconds": …}}` and compares under
`all`/`any`/`not`.

filter.description:
Which of them it acts on: compares under `all`/`any`/`not`; null:
every one.

group.description: The batch it was created in: every trigger of one create shares it.

oneOf.description: What its last round saw; null before its first round. Always present.

selector.description:
Which wallet indexes it acts on: `{"ids": […]}`, `{"asset": "…"}`,
`{"tag": "…"}`, `{"untagged": {}}`, `{"all": […]}`, `{"any": […]}`, `{"not": …}`.

TriggerBatch.description: `POST /v1/triggers` body: triggers of one network stored together, all or none.

triggers.description: One to 16 triggers, each with its `id`.
The batch's triggers, in its order.

TriggerDefinition.description: A trigger as written: in a `POST` (with `id`) or as a `PUT` body.

id.description: Its slug; required in a `POST`, refused in a `PUT` (the path names it).

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

TriggerRun.description:
One run of a trigger: when it started, the send jobs it queued and how
they ended.

jobs.description: Its send jobs, in the order queued; a job no longer kept is left out.

oneOf.description: Where its jobs are together; null when none of them is kept.

stats.description:
What its round saw: wallets selected, kept by the filter, whether
the check held, and send jobs queued.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.

TriggerStats.description:
What one round saw of a trigger: how many wallet indexes its selector
picked, how many of them its filter kept, whether its check held over
those, and how many effects its action returned.

checked.description: Whether its check held over the kept ones.

kept.description: How many of them its filter kept (all of them without a filter).

index_state.description:
`paused`: skipped, no facts kept for blocks while paused; `indexing`:
resumed from `paused` or `no_data` (clearing its reason), backfilling
what it missed. `no_data` is the indexer's to set.

Wallet.description:
One wallet, as the API shows it: an address, whether its key is kept,
its tags, and its indexes (each with its balances, progress and legs;
read by [`db::find`] and [`db::find_page`], empty from the other
reads). The key (`curve`, `secret`) is never serialized, and the API
reads leave it out. No `Debug`: it may hold the key.

external_id.description:
The caller's own reference for it (e.g. their customer id), 1 to 128
characters; not unique. Null when none was given.

indexes.description: Its indexes by asset id (`native` or the token id).

keyed.description: Whether this server holds its key and can send from it.

tags.description: Its tags, sorted, each once, each [`is_tag`].

WalletIndex.description:
One asset of one wallet being indexed, as every read answers it (the
API shows it as is): its columns, how far it is indexed against its
network's tip, its balances and its pending legs. All computed in SQL
(`wallet_index_with_balance`); amounts are exact atomic decimal text, never summed.
Positions are native (height or slot).

balance_confirmed.description:
Its confirmed balance: its last live mined leg's total at or below
`finality_at`, `0` without one; negative when indexed debits exceed
indexed credits (history before the start or a jump is unknown);
null while `finality_at` is unknown.

balance_confirmed_received.description:
What it had received by then (that leg's `total_received`):
`balance_confirmed` is `balance_confirmed_received -
balance_confirmed_sent` plus its adjustments.

balance_confirmed_sent.description: What it had sent by then (fees included), the same way.

balance_confirmed_spendable.description:
What it can spend: `balance_confirmed` less its outgoing legs not yet
in it (pending, or mined above `finality_at`); null while
`balance_confirmed` is.

balance_pending.description:
What it will hold once every pending transaction lands: its newest
live mined leg's total, any block (`0` without one), with what this
server sent and is not mined yet, in and out; null before its first
block (`indexed_through`), as every balance is.

behind_tip.description:
Blocks between `indexed_through` and the network's produced tip;
null before the first block or without a tip.

birthday.description:
The start indexed from: the one asked for, or the first block the
node served when it no longer served that one.

finality_at.description:
The network's final (confirmed) block: its indexer's, or a trigger
round's; null when unknown.

indexed_through.description: The last block indexed; null before the first.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page. Always
present.
